caption: The video captures a light-haired performer viewed from behind, standing centered on a glossy stage floor scattered with red and gold fragments. They wear a black shirt and dark trousers, with a guitar slung across their back, its neck protruding left and body resting at the right hip. Two bright spotlights glow through drifting haze. The performer’s arms are bent near the torso, then sweep outward and upward into a wide raised V, hands opening toward the lights. During this motion, their heels lift and shift before the feet settle. The outstretched pose is held with small changes in arm angle and hand position. Smoke continues to swirl slowly around the fixed lights and stage debris.
